U 表示变量总体，\(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{fin}}(U)\) 表示其所有有限子集。每次参与求和的 S、T 都有限；变量总体本身可以无限。论文应用则固定有限总体 N，只讨论 \(2^N\)。

definitions.text_md: 交互是有限交替和。\(T\subseteq S\) 保证 |T|≤|S|，因此指数 \(|S|-|T|\) 是非负整数。
\(R_d\) 是在给定保留变量集 S 上累加所有被激活的系数。
插入差分比较保留 i 与掩码 i 两种状态。下面的插入引理只在 \(i\notin S\) 时使用。

shared_proofs.overview: 每次插入新变量 $i$，把子集分成含 $i$ 与不含 $i$ 两类。含 $i$ 的交互等于插入差分的交互；对两类分别应用加强归纳假设，中间输出相消，留下当前输出。

proof_steps.title: 辅助引理：为什么子集能分成两组
proof_steps.body_md: 固定有限集合 S 及不属于 S 的变量 i。\(S\cup \{i\}\) 的任何子集 A，要么不含 i，这时 A 本身就是 S 的子集；要么含 i，这时唯一地写成 \(A=T\cup \{i\}\)，其中 \(T=A\setminus \{i\}\subseteq S\)。两类互不重叠，且各自覆盖所有可能情况，所以对任意实值函数 F 可以把有限和改写为下面的两组和。没有遗漏空集：它出现在第一组 \(T=\varnothing\)；第二组 \(T=\varnothing\) 对应 {i}。
proof_steps.justification: 子集与不含/含 i 两类的显式一一对应。

lean_refs.explanation_md: 插入引理证明内实际使用子集拆分；这一步没有另增一个项目定理。

proof_steps.title: 辅助引理：展开符号，得到插入差分
proof_steps.body_md: 把上一步用于交互 \(I_g(S\cup \{i\})\) 的定义。每个 \(T\subseteq S\) 都满足 \(i\notin T\)，因此 \(|S\cup \{i\}|=|S|+1\)、\(|T\cup \{i\}|=|T|+1\)。令 \(k=|S|-|T|\ge 0\)：第一组的系数是 \((-1)^{k+1}=-(-1)^k\)；第二组的系数是 \((-1)^k\)。把同一 T 的两项合并，得到 \((-1)^k\)[\(g(T\cup \{i\})−g(T)\)]。最后一行正是 \(I_{\Delta_i g}(S)\) 的定义。
proof_steps.justification: \(i\notin S\) 及 \(T\subseteq S\) 给出两个插入基数；整数幂的递推关系给出负号；有限和逐项相加。

lean_refs.explanation_md: 这个三行等式是已存在 interaction_insert 的完整数学内容；h1/h2 位于该声明证明内。

proof_steps.title: 主证明：加强归纳命题，并处理空集
proof_steps.body_md:
对有限集合 S 作插入归纳，但归纳命题必须说“对任意集合函数 g 都有 \(R_{I_g}(S)=g(S)\)”。不能只固定最初的 g 后归纳，因为插入一步还要对新函数 \(\Delta_i g\) 使用归纳假设。

当 \(S=\varnothing\) 时，空集只有一个子集，即自身。定义中的指数是 0，(−1)^0=1，所以 \(I_g(\varnothing )=g(\varnothing )\)，而重构和也只有这一项。这是归纳起点；无需且不能在这里默默令 \(g(\varnothing )\)=0。
proof_steps.justification: 有限集合插入归纳；空集的子集族只有空集本身；空集交互公式。

lean_refs.explanation_md: 归纳语句 generalizing v 以及 empty 分支都在 reconstruction 的现有证明内。

proof_steps.title: 主证明：对两组和分别使用归纳假设
proof_steps.body_md: 现在设 \(i\notin S\)，并假设任意函数 h 在 S 上都满足 \(R_{I_h}(S)\)=h(S)。第一步的拆分把 \(S\cup \{i\}\) 上的重构和写成两组。对第二组中的每个 \(T\subseteq S\)，仍有 \(i\notin T\)，所以第二步的插入交互引理可以逐项使用。得到的第二组是 \(\Delta_i g\) 在 S 上的交互总和。对第一组用归纳假设 h=g，对第二组用归纳假设 h=\(\Delta_i g\)，便分别得到 \(g(S)\) 与 \(\Delta_i g(S)\)。这里明确使用了两次同一个归纳假设，而不是假设差分的结论未经证明成立。
proof_steps.justification: 子集拆分；插入交互引理逐项使用；加强归纳假设适用于任意集合函数。

lean_refs.explanation_md: 现有代码的 sum_congr、ih v 和 ih (marginal v i) 分别实现逐项替换和两次归纳应用。

proof_steps.title: 主证明：消去中间输出，完成归纳
proof_steps.body_md: 按插入差分的定义，\(\Delta_i g(S)=g(S\cup \{i\})-g(S)\)。将其代入上一步，\(g(S)\) 与 −\(g(S)\) 在实数加法中消去，得到所需的 \(g(S\cup \{i\})\)。空集起点与每次插入的步骤已经覆盖所有有限 S，因此对任意有限 S 的重构恒等式成立。论文中只需把这里的 \(g(S)\) 换成固定模型和掩码规则给出的 \(v(x_S)\)。
proof_steps.justification: 插入差分定义与实数加减法；有限集合归纳结论。

    Eq.{1} (Harsanyi.interaction.{u_1} v (Insert.insert.{u_1, u_1} i S))

lean.adapter_code:
theorem interaction_insert (v : Game α) (S : Finset α) (i : α) (hi : i ∉ S) :
    interaction v (insert i S) = interaction (marginal v i) S := by
  unfold interaction marginal
  rw [sum_powerset_insert hi]
  have h1 : ∀ T ∈ S.powerset,
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ ((insert i S).card - T.card) * v T =
      -((-1 : ℝ) ^ (S.card - T.card) * v T) := by
    intro T hT
    have hTS := card_le_card (mem_powerset.mp hT)
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem hi]
    have he : S.card + 1 - T.card = (S.card - T.card) + 1 := by omega
    rw [he, pow_succ]
    ring
  have h2 : ∀ T ∈ S.powerset,
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ ((insert i S).card - (insert i T).card) * v (insert i T) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (S.card - T.card) * v (insert i T) := by
    intro T hT
    have hiT : i ∉ T := fun hit => hi ((mem_powerset.mp hT) hit)
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem hi, card_insert_of_notMem hiT]
    simp
  rw [sum_congr rfl h1, sum_congr rfl h2, ← sum_add_distrib]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro T _
  ring

/-- All dividends reconstruct every finite coalition, without a baseline assumption. -/

theorem reconstruction (v : Game α) (S : Finset α) :
    reconstruct (interaction v) S = v S := by
  induction S using Finset.induction_on generalizing v with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i S hi ih =>
    unfold reconstruct
    rw [sum_powerset_insert hi]
    have h : ∀ T ∈ S.powerset,
        interaction v (insert i T) = interaction (marginal v i) T := by
      intro T hT
      exact interaction_insert v T i (fun hit => hi ((mem_powerset.mp hT) hit))
    rw [sum_congr rfl h]
    change reconstruct (interaction v) S + reconstruct (interaction (marginal v i)) S = _
    rw [ih v, ih (marginal v i)]
    simp [marginal]

/-- The converse Boolean Möbius inversion: transforming subset sums recovers coefficients. -/

en.title: Shared proof: exact reconstruction of every masked output

assumptions.text_md: The coalition is finite. The games and coefficient functions are arbitrary real-valued functions on finite subsets; continuity, differentiability, independence and a zero output baseline are unnecessary.
The ambient universe may be infinite, but every coalition in a sum is finite. Paper applications fix a finite universe and use its powerset.

definitions.text_md: The interaction is a finite alternating sum. Since the summation subset is contained in the target, the cardinality difference in its exponent is a nonnegative integer.
Reconstruction sums all coefficients activated by the retained-variable set.
The insertion difference compares retaining the distinguished variable with masking it. The insertion lemma below is used only when that variable is absent from the target.

en.overview: Insertion separates subsets with and without the new variable. The insertion interaction becomes a finite difference; strengthened induction reconstructs both games and cancels the intermediate output.
en.completion_scope: The public finite-set reconstruction theorem and its actual library induction; paper specializations are separate.
en.example_md: For two variables with mask outputs 2, 5, 7 and 13, the dividends are 2, 3, 5 and 3. Their full sum is 13, the empty-mask sum is 2, and singleton reconstruction gives 5 and 7. If only the full output 13 were required, coefficients 0, 0, 0 and 13 would also fit that one mask but fail all others. Hence the universal mask requirement matters.
caveats: The human proof explains the existing library declarations; its five steps do not introduce five new Lean theorems. The checked scope consists of the library theorem and separately compiled paper adapters.
Every subset sum includes the empty coefficient. If it is omitted, add the output baseline outside the sum.

The source uses double sums and binomial cancellation; the library uses insertion induction or converse inversion. These are separately identified proof routes, not a claim of line-by-line formal translation.

proof_steps.title: Partition the subsets into two families
proof_steps.body_md: Fix finite $S$ and $i\notin S$. Every subset of $S\cup\{i\}$ either excludes $i$, and is a subset $T$ of $S$, or includes $i$, and uniquely equals $T\cup\{i\}$ with $T\subseteq S$. The families are disjoint and exhaustive, so any finite sum of a function $F$ splits into these two sums. The empty subset occurs in the first family; empty $T$ in the second family produces $\{i\}$.
proof_steps.justification: The explicit bijections for subsets with and without the inserted variable.

proof_steps.title: Expand the signs to obtain the insertion difference
proof_steps.body_md: Every $T\subseteq S$ excludes $i$, so the two inserted cardinalities are $|S|+1$ and $|T|+1$. Put $k=|S|-|T|\ge0$. The coefficient of $g(T)$ is $(-1)^{k+1}=-(-1)^k$, and the coefficient of $g(T\cup\{i\})$ is $(-1)^k$. Combining the paired terms gives $(-1)^k[g(T\cup\{i\})-g(T)]$. The resulting sum is the interaction of $\Delta_i g$ on $S$.
proof_steps.justification: Insertion cardinalities, the recurrence for integer powers, and finite distributivity.

proof_steps.title: Strengthen the induction statement and handle the empty set
proof_steps.body_md: Induct by inserting elements into finite $S$, with the strengthened statement that reconstruction holds for every game $g$. This quantification is necessary because the next step applies induction to the new game $\Delta_i g$. When $S=\varnothing$, its only subset is itself; the exponent is zero, so both interaction and reconstruction equal $g(\varnothing)$. No zero-baseline assumption is used.
proof_steps.justification: Finite-set insertion induction and the exact empty-interaction formula.

proof_steps.title: Apply induction to each of the two sums
proof_steps.body_md: Assume that every game $h$ is reconstructed on $S$, and let $i\notin S$. Split the reconstruction on $S\cup\{i\}$ into the two families from the first step. In the family containing $i$, each $T\subseteq S$ still excludes $i$, so apply the insertion-difference identity term by term. The two sums become reconstruction for $g$ and reconstruction for $\Delta_i g$ on $S$. The same strengthened induction hypothesis gives $g(S)$ and $\Delta_i g(S)$ respectively.
proof_steps.justification: Subset partition, the insertion identity, and induction quantified over all games.

proof_steps.title: Cancel the intermediate output and finish induction
proof_steps.body_md: By definition, $\Delta_i g(S)=g(S\cup\{i\})-g(S)$. Adding it to $g(S)$ cancels the intermediate value and leaves the required output on the inserted set. The empty case and insertion step cover every finite set. For a paper application, instantiate the game with $g(S)=v(x_S)$ using one fixed model, input and mask rule.
proof_steps.justification: The finite-difference definition and real addition and subtraction.

shared_proofs.title: 公共证明：同时重构所有掩码输出的系数唯一

assumptions.text_md: S 是有限变量集合。g 与 d 是定义在有限变量子集上的任意实值函数；不要求连续、可微、独立性或零输出基线。
U 表示变量总体，\(\mathcal P_{\mathrm{fin}}(U)\) 表示其所有有限子集。每次参与求和的 S、T 都有限；变量总体本身可以无限。论文应用则固定有限总体 N，只讨论 \(2^N\)。
同一组系数 d 必须重构定义域内每一个有限子集的输出，包括空集。只在一个指定集合上重构不够。

definitions.text_md: 交互是有限交替和。\(T\subseteq S\) 保证 |T|≤|S|，因此指数 \(|S|-|T|\) 是非负整数。
\(R_d\) 是在给定保留变量集 S 上累加所有被激活的系数。
插入差分比较保留 i 与掩码 i 两种状态。下面的插入引理只在 \(i\notin S\) 时使用。

shared_proofs.overview: 把“对系数求子集和”再做一次交替差分，会恢复原系数。这是逆向 Möbius 反演 \(I_{R_d}=d\)。先证明这个辅助结论，再把“所有掩码上 \(R_d=g\)”的假设代入，就得到 \(d=I_g\)。下面完整证明所需的逆向反演，给出唯一性成立的理由。

proof_steps.title: 辅助引理：逆向反演的归纳起点
proof_steps.body_md:
先暂时不使用 \(R_d=g\)，单独证明任意系数函数 d 都满足 \(I_{R_d}(S)=d(S)\)。同样对有限 S 插入归纳，并把 d 保留为任意函数，因为插入步骤会引入新函数 e。

若 \(S=\varnothing\)，则 \(R_d(\varnothing )=d(\varnothing )\)。再由空集交互等于被变换函数的空集值，得 \(I_{R_d}(\varnothing )=R_d(\varnothing )=d(\varnothing )\)。这是逆向反演的起点，也说明空集系数并非可以随意选择的额外自由参数。
proof_steps.justification: 重构定义、空集交互公式与加强归纳。

lean_refs.explanation_md: interaction_reconstruct 对 S 归纳并 generalizing d；这一步为其 empty 分支。

proof_steps.title: 辅助引理：重构函数的差分也是一个重构
proof_steps.body_md:
设 \(i\notin S\)，并定义新的系数函数 \(e(U)=d(U\cup \{i\})\)。对任意 \(T\subseteq S\)，都有 \(i\notin T\)，可将 \(R_d(T\cup \{i\})\) 按不含/含 i 的子集拆成 \(R_d(T)\) 加 \(\sum _{U\subseteq T}d(U\cup \{i\})\)。减去 \(R_d(T)\) 后，留下的恰好是 \(R_e(T)\)。

注意该等式只在 \(T\subseteq S\) 的范围使用。若 T 已含 i，子集拆分就不再是两类互不重叠；这个局部等式不需要、也不能强行推广到不受 \(T\subseteq S\) 限制的每个 T。
proof_steps.formula_tex: \begin{aligned}(\Delta_i R_d)(T)&=R_d(T\cup\{i\})-R_d(T)\\&=\left(\sum_{U\subseteq T}d(U)+\sum_{U\subseteq T}d(U\cup\{i\})\right)-\sum_{U\subseteq T}d(U)\\&=\sum_{U\subseteq T}e(U)=R_e(T),\qquad T\subseteq S.\end{aligned}
proof_steps.justification: \(i\notin T\)；子集拆分；相同有限和消去；e 与 \(R_e\) 的定义。

lean_refs.explanation_md: 库证明中的局部 h 使用 sum_powerset_insert；e 在代码中是 fun T => d (insert i T)。

proof_steps.title: 辅助引理：从局部一致性完成插入步骤
proof_steps.body_md: 先用重构证明中的插入交互引理，得到 \(I_{R_d}(S\cup \{i\})=I_{\Delta_i R_d}(S)\)。交互 \(I_h(S)\) 只读取 h 在 S 的子集上的值；第二步已经逐个证明 \(\Delta_i R_d(T)=R_e(T)\)，故两种函数在这次交替和中的每一项相同。因此 \(I_{\Delta_i R_d}(S)=I_{R_e}(S)\)。最后用“对任意系数函数”的归纳假设，将 \(I_{R_e}(S)\) 化为 \(e(S)=d(S\cup \{i\})\)。这样证明了逆向反演在插入集合上的结论。
proof_steps.justification: 插入交互引理；交互对参与求和的局部函数值保持一致；加强归纳假设。

lean_refs.explanation_md: 这里只要求在 S 的所有子集上相同，不要求两函数处处相同。
库证明的 rw [h, ih] 完成该辅助引理。

proof_steps.title: 主证明：将全部掩码的重构假设代入
proof_steps.body_md: 现在恢复假设 ∀T，\(R_d(T)=g(T)\)。固定任意 S。由刚证完的逆向反演，\(d(S)=I_{R_d}(S)\)。在定义 \(I_{R_d}(S)\) 的有限和中，每个 U 都满足 \(U\subseteq S\)，重构假设给出 \(R_d(U)=g(U)\)。逐项替换后，该和就是 \(I_g(S)\)。因此 \(d(S)=I_g(S)\)。这一步使用的是同一组 d 在所有掩码上的假设，而不是每个 S 临时选一组系数。
proof_steps.justification: 逆向反演与逐个子集上的重构假设。

lean_refs.explanation_md: reconstruction_unique 中先改写 interaction_reconstruct，再用 interaction_congr 将 h T 代入。

proof_steps.title: 主证明：逐点相等与适用范围
proof_steps.body_md:
S 是任意有限子集，所以 d 与 \(I_g\) 在定义域的每个输入上取相同值，这正是两个函数相等的含义。本公共命题的量词遍历 U 的所有有限子集；应用于论文时把总体固定为有限 N，函数定义域随之取为 \(2^N\)。

特别取 \(S=\varnothing\)，重构假设强制 \(d(\varnothing )=g(\varnothing )\)。取 \(S=\{i\}\)，又强制 \(d(\{i\})=g(\{i\})−g(\varnothing )\)。继续增加集合，新的最高阶系数会被已经确定的低阶子集系数唯一决定；这解释了原论文按阶数归纳的直观路线。
proof_steps.justification: 函数外延性；论文适配使用固定有限总体。

lean_refs.explanation_md: funext S 在声明开头说明函数相等的含义。

shared_proofs.example_md:
取 \(N=\{1,2\}\)，并指定 \(g(\varnothing)=2\)、\(g(\{1\})=5\)、\(g(\{2\})=7\)、\(g(\{1,2\})=13\)。任何满足全部掩码重构的 d 都必须依次满足
\[d(\varnothing)=2,\quad d(\{1\})=5-2=3,\quad d(\{2\})=7-2=5,\]
\[d(\{1,2\})=13-2-3-5=3.\]
如果只要求完整输入输出等于 13，另一组 \(d(\varnothing),d(\{1\}),d(\{2\}),d(\{1,2\})=(0,0,0,13)\) 也能满足这一条等式，却在全掩码时输出 0、在单变量掩码时也输出 0。因此“所有 \(S\subseteq N\)”的量词不可删除。

lean.adapter_code:
theorem interaction_reconstruct (d : Game α) (S : Finset α) :
    interaction (reconstruct d) S = d S := by
  induction S using Finset.induction_on generalizing d with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i S hi ih =>
    rw [interaction_insert _ _ _ hi]
    have h : interaction (marginal (reconstruct d) i) S =
        interaction (reconstruct (fun T => d (insert i T))) S := by
      apply interaction_congr
      intro T hT
      have hiT : i ∉ T := fun hit => hi (hT hit)
      simp only [marginal, reconstruct, sum_powerset_insert hiT, add_sub_cancel_left]
    rw [h, ih]

/-- Dividends are the unique coefficients that reconstruct all coalitions. -/

theorem reconstruction_unique (v d : Game α)
    (h : ∀ S, reconstruct d S = v S) : d = interaction v := by
  funext S
  rw [← interaction_reconstruct d S]
  apply interaction_congr
  intro T _
  exact h T

theorem interaction_insert (v : Game α) (S : Finset α) (i : α) (hi : i ∉ S) :
    interaction v (insert i S) = interaction (marginal v i) S := by
  unfold interaction marginal
  rw [sum_powerset_insert hi]
  have h1 : ∀ T ∈ S.powerset,
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ ((insert i S).card - T.card) * v T =
      -((-1 : ℝ) ^ (S.card - T.card) * v T) := by
    intro T hT
    have hTS := card_le_card (mem_powerset.mp hT)
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem hi]
    have he : S.card + 1 - T.card = (S.card - T.card) + 1 := by omega
    rw [he, pow_succ]
    ring
  have h2 : ∀ T ∈ S.powerset,
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ ((insert i S).card - (insert i T).card) * v (insert i T) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (S.card - T.card) * v (insert i T) := by
    intro T hT
    have hiT : i ∉ T := fun hit => hi ((mem_powerset.mp hT) hit)
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem hi, card_insert_of_notMem hiT]
    simp
  rw [sum_congr rfl h1, sum_congr rfl h2, ← sum_add_distrib]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro T _
  ring

/-- All dividends reconstruct every finite coalition, without a baseline assumption. -/

en.title: Shared proof: uniqueness of coefficients reconstructing all masks

assumptions.text_md: The coalition is finite. The games and coefficient functions are arbitrary real-valued functions on finite subsets; continuity, differentiability, independence and a zero output baseline are unnecessary.
The ambient universe may be infinite, but every coalition in a sum is finite. Paper applications fix a finite universe and use its powerset.
The same coefficients must reconstruct every finite subset in the domain, including the empty set. Reconstruction at one specified coalition is insufficient.

definitions.text_md: The interaction is a finite alternating sum. Since the summation subset is contained in the target, the cardinality difference in its exponent is a nonnegative integer.
Reconstruction sums all coefficients activated by the retained-variable set.
The insertion difference compares retaining the distinguished variable with masking it. The insertion lemma below is used only when that variable is absent from the target.

en.overview: Prove converse Möbius inversion for arbitrary coefficients, then substitute the reconstruction equality at every mask and conclude pointwise equality.
en.completion_scope: Coefficient uniqueness and the converse inversion actually used by the library; finite-universe paper quantifiers are recorded by separate adapters.
en.example_md: For two variables with mask outputs 2, 5, 7 and 13, the dividends are 2, 3, 5 and 3. Their full sum is 13, the empty-mask sum is 2, and singleton reconstruction gives 5 and 7. If only the full output 13 were required, coefficients 0, 0, 0 and 13 would also fit that one mask but fail all others. Hence the universal mask requirement matters.
caveats: Uniqueness concerns coefficients for one fixed game and the same AND activation rule. It does not assert uniqueness of every explanation framework, causal model or AND–OR decomposition.
The source inducts on cardinality; the library proves converse inversion. This text fully explains the route actually used by the library.
Every subset, including the empty one, must be reconstructed exactly. Fitting only the full input, or fitting approximately, does not satisfy the theorem.

proof_steps.title: Prove converse inversion at the empty set
proof_steps.body_md: First prove $I_{R_d}(S)=d(S)$ for an arbitrary coefficient function $d$, without using the reconstruction hypothesis. Induct on finite $S$ and keep $d$ universally quantified. At the empty set, $R_d(\varnothing)=d(\varnothing)$, and the empty interaction of this game has that same value. Thus the empty coefficient is fixed rather than an additional free parameter.
proof_steps.justification: The definitions and strengthened finite-set induction.

proof_steps.title: The difference of a reconstruction is another reconstruction
proof_steps.body_md: For $i\notin S$, define $e(U)=d(U\cup\{i\})$. Every $T\subseteq S$ excludes $i$, so splitting the subsets of $T\cup\{i\}$ gives $R_d(T\cup\{i\})=R_d(T)+\sum_{U\subseteq T}d(U\cup\{i\})$. Subtraction leaves $R_e(T)$. This identity is used only for $T\subseteq S$: when $i\in T$, the two-family argument would no longer be disjoint.
proof_steps.justification: The subset partition, cancellation of finite sums, and the definition of the new coefficient function.

proof_steps.title: Use local equality to prove the insertion step
proof_steps.body_md: The insertion lemma gives $I_{R_d}(S\cup\{i\})=I_{\Delta_i R_d}(S)$. The interaction on $S$ reads only values at subsets of $S$, where the previous step proves that $\Delta_i R_d$ equals $R_e$. Hence its interaction equals $I_{R_e}(S)$. Apply the induction hypothesis for the arbitrary function $e$ to obtain $e(S)=d(S\cup\{i\})$. This proves converse inversion on the inserted set.
proof_steps.justification: Insertion differences, congruence on the subsets actually used, and strengthened induction.

proof_steps.title: Substitute the reconstruction hypothesis for every mask
proof_steps.body_md: Restore the assumption that the same $d$ satisfies $R_d(T)=g(T)$ at every finite $T$. For arbitrary $S$, converse inversion gives $d(S)=I_{R_d}(S)$. In this finite sum every argument $U$ is a subset of $S$, so the assumption replaces $R_d(U)$ by $g(U)$ term by term. The resulting sum is $I_g(S)$. Coefficients are not chosen afresh for each mask.
proof_steps.justification: Converse inversion and the reconstruction equality at each subset.

proof_steps.title: Conclude function equality and check the application domain
proof_steps.body_md: Since $S$ is arbitrary, equality at every finite input gives $d=I_g$. The public result quantifies over all finite subsets of a universe that may itself be infinite; a paper application restricts this universe to its finite $N$. In particular, the empty mask forces $d(\varnothing)=g(\varnothing)$, and a singleton forces $d(\{i\})=g(\{i\})-g(\varnothing)$. Higher coefficients are then fixed by the already determined proper-subset coefficients.
proof_steps.justification: Function extensionality and the finite-universe paper specialization.

en.title: Shared proof: linearity of interactions
assumptions: $g,h:\mathcal P(N)\to\mathbb R$; $A\subseteq N$.

definitions.body_md: Fix a finite universe $N$. A game $g:\mathcal P(N)\to\mathbb R$ has output baseline $b=g(\varnothing)$ and interaction $I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U)$. Write $w_A=I_g(A)$. Every subset sum includes the empty set, and $w_\varnothing=b$. The finite difference is $\Delta_Tg(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}g(L\cup S)$. No zero output baseline is assumed. Centering $g_0=g-b$ removes only the empty dividend.

proof_steps.title: Apply the premise at the actual summation argument
proof_steps.body_md: Assume $g_v(U)=g_t(U)+g_u(U)$ for every $U\subseteq N$. For a fixed $A$, each $U\subseteq A$ lies in that domain. The original proof wrote the fixed output at $x_A$ inside the alternating sum; the repaired proof uses the output at the summation argument $x_U$ in every term, preserving the original proposition.

proof_steps.title: Distribute within the finite sum
proof_steps.body_md: For each $U\subseteq A$, distribute its alternating coefficient over the two outputs. Then distribute the finite sum over addition. The two resulting sums are exactly $I_{g_t}(A)$ and $I_{g_u}(A)$.

proof_steps.title: Check the empty set and a constant example
proof_steps.body_md: For $A=\varnothing$, the identity states $b_v=b_t+b_u$; none of these baselines needs to vanish. For constant models with values 2 and 5, their sum has value 7: its empty dividend is 7 and every nonempty dividend is zero.

definitions.body_md: 固定有限总体 $N$。集合函数 $g:\mathcal P(N)\to\mathbb R$ 的输出基线为 $b=g(\varnothing)$，交互为 $I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U)$。记 $w_A=I_g(A)$。所有子集和包括空集，且 $w_\varnothing=b$。差分为 $\Delta_Tg(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}g(L\cup S)$。原始输出不要求零基线；中心化函数 $g_0=g-b$ 仅使空交互变为零。

proof_steps.title: 把含i的子集按是否含i分组

step_map.lean_excerpt:
theorem interaction_insert (v : Game α) (S : Finset α) (i : α) (hi : i ∉ S) :
    interaction v (insert i S) = interaction (marginal v i) S := by
  unfold interaction marginal
  rw [sum_powerset_insert hi]
  have h1 : ∀ T ∈ S.powerset,
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ ((insert i S).card - T.card) * v T =
      -((-1 : ℝ) ^ (S.card - T.card) * v T) := by
    intro T hT
    have hTS := card_le_card (mem_powerset.mp hT)
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem hi]
    have he : S.card + 1 - T.card = (S.card - T.card) + 1 := by omega
    rw [he, pow_succ]
    ring
  have h2 : ∀ T ∈ S.powerset,
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ ((insert i S).card - (insert i T).card) * v (insert i T) =
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (S.card - T.card) * v (insert i T) := by
    intro T hT
    have hiT : i ∉ T := fun hit => hi ((mem_powerset.mp hT) hit)
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem hi, card_insert_of_notMem hiT]
    simp
  rw [sum_congr rfl h1, sum_congr rfl h2, ← sum_add_distrib]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro T _
  ring

theorem interaction_relabel {β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] (e : α ≃ β)
    (v : Game α) (S : Finset α) :
    interaction (fun U => v (U.map e.symm.toEmbedding)) (S.map e.toEmbedding) =
      interaction v S := by
  unfold interaction
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun U _ => U.map e.symm.toEmbedding) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro U hU
    apply mem_powerset.mpr
    have h : U.map e.symm.toEmbedding ⊆ (S.map e.toEmbedding).map e.symm.toEmbedding :=
      Finset.map_subset_map.mpr (mem_powerset.mp hU)
    simpa [Finset.map_map] using h
  · intro U _ V _ h
    exact Finset.map_injective e.symm.toEmbedding h
  · intro T hT
    refine ⟨T.map e.toEmbedding, mem_powerset.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (Finset.map_subset_map.mpr (mem_powerset.mp hT))
    · simp [Finset.map_map]
  · intro U _
    simp

proof_steps.title: Evaluate at the target itself

theorem reconstruct_union_disjoint (d : Game α) (A B : Finset α)
    (hAB : Disjoint A B) :
    reconstruct d (A ∪ B) =
      ∑ U ∈ A.powerset, ∑ V ∈ B.powerset, d (U ∪ V) := by
  induction A using Finset.induction_on generalizing d with
  | empty => simp [reconstruct]
  | @insert i A hi ih =>
    have hA : Disjoint A B := disjoint_of_subset_left (subset_insert i A) hAB
    have hiB : i ∉ B := by
      intro hit
      exact (Finset.disjoint_left.mp hAB (mem_insert_self i A) hit)
    have hiAB : i ∉ A ∪ B := by simp [hi, hiB]
    rw [insert_union, reconstruct, sum_powerset_insert hiAB]
    change reconstruct d (A ∪ B) + reconstruct (fun U => d (insert i U)) (A ∪ B) = _
    rw [ih d hA, ih (fun U => d (insert i U)) hA, sum_powerset_insert hi]
    simp_rw [insert_union]

assumptions: $T,E\subseteq N$，$T\cap E=\varnothing$；$k\in\mathbb N$、$k>0$；$m=|E|$。

definitions.body_md: 固定有限总体 $N$。集合函数 $g:\mathcal P(N)\to\mathbb R$ 的输出基线为 $b=g(\varnothing)$，交互为 $I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U)$。记 $w_A=I_g(A)$。所有子集和包括空集，且 $w_\varnothing=b$。差分为 $\Delta_Tg(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}g(L\cup S)$。原始输出不要求零基线；中心化函数 $g_0=g-b$ 仅使空交互变为零。

proof_steps.title: 完整辅助引理：有限阶乘卷积
proof_steps.body_md: 对任意有限集合 $R$、非负整数 $a,b$，记 $m=|R|$，$F_R(a,b)=\sum_{A\subseteq R}(a+|A|)!(b+m-|A|)!$。对 $R$ 作插入归纳，并加强归纳命题为对所有 $a,b$ 成立。$R=\varnothing$ 时两边都是 $a!b!$。插入新变量 $i\notin R$ 后，按 $A$ 是否含 $i$ 分组得到 $F_{R\cup\{i\}}(a,b)=F_R(a,b+1)+F_R(a+1,b)$。归纳假设给出的两项有共同分母 $(a+b+2)!$ 和共同大阶乘 $(a+b+m+2)!$，小阶乘相加为 $a!(b+1)!+(a+1)!b!=a!b!(a+b+2)$。约去正数 $a+b+2$ 得插入后的公式。全部阶乘为正，除法合法；论证包括 $a=0$、$b=0$、$m=0$。

theorem factorial_powerset_sum (R : Finset α) (a b : ℕ) :
    (∑ U ∈ R.powerset, ((a + U.card).factorial : ℝ) *
      ((b + R.card - U.card).factorial : ℝ)) =
    (a.factorial : ℝ) * (b.factorial : ℝ) *
      ((a + b + R.card + 1).factorial : ℝ) / ((a + b + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
  have fact_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro n
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n
  have fact_succ : ∀ n : ℕ, ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) =
      (n + 1 : ℝ) * (n.factorial : ℝ) := by
    intro n
    simp [Nat.factorial_succ]
  induction R using Finset.induction_on generalizing a b with
  | empty =>
    simp only [powerset_empty, sum_singleton, card_empty, Nat.add_zero, Nat.sub_zero]
    field_simp [fact_ne]
  | @insert i R hi ih =>
    rw [sum_powerset_insert hi, card_insert_of_notMem hi]
    have h₁ : ∀ U ∈ R.powerset,
        ((a + U.card).factorial : ℝ) * ((b + (R.card + 1) - U.card).factorial : ℝ) =
          ((a + U.card).factorial : ℝ) * (((b + 1) + R.card - U.card).factorial : ℝ) := by
      intro U hU
      have he : b + (R.card + 1) - U.card = (b + 1) + R.card - U.card := by omega
      rw [he]
    have h₂ : ∀ U ∈ R.powerset,
        ((a + (insert i U).card).factorial : ℝ) *
          ((b + (R.card + 1) - (insert i U).card).factorial : ℝ) =
        (((a + 1) + U.card).factorial : ℝ) * ((b + R.card - U.card).factorial : ℝ) := by
      intro U hU
      have hiU : i ∉ U := fun hit => hi ((mem_powerset.mp hU) hit)
      rw [card_insert_of_notMem hiU]
      have hc := card_le_card (mem_powerset.mp hU)
      have he₁ : a + (U.card + 1) = (a + 1) + U.card := by omega
      have he₂ : b + (R.card + 1) - (U.card + 1) = b + R.card - U.card := by omega
      rw [he₁, he₂]
    rw [sum_congr rfl h₁, sum_congr rfl h₂, ih a (b + 1), ih (a + 1) b]
    have hd₁ : a + (b + 1) + 1 = (a + b + 1) + 1 := by omega

en.title: Shared auxiliary proof: finite factorial convolution, including empty boundaries
assumptions: $T,E\subseteq N$, $T\cap E=\varnothing$; $k\in\mathbb N$, $k>0$; $m=|E|$.

definitions.body_md: Fix a finite universe $N$. A game $g:\mathcal P(N)\to\mathbb R$ has output baseline $b=g(\varnothing)$ and interaction $I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U)$. Write $w_A=I_g(A)$. Every subset sum includes the empty set, and $w_\varnothing=b$. The finite difference is $\Delta_Tg(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}g(L\cup S)$. No zero output baseline is assumed. Centering $g_0=g-b$ removes only the empty dividend.

proof_steps.title: Prove the finite factorial convolution
proof_steps.body_md: For finite $R$ of size $m$, define $F_R(a,b)=\sum_{A\subseteq R}(a+|A|)!(b+m-|A|)!$. Induct on $R$ with the statement strengthened to every nonnegative $a,b$. At the empty set both sides are $a!b!$. Inserting a new element splits the sum as $F_R(a,b+1)+F_R(a+1,b)$. The induction expressions share denominator $(a+b+2)!$ and large factorial $(a+b+m+2)!$. The smaller factorials combine as $a!(b+1)!+(a+1)!b!=a!b!(a+b+2)$. Cancelling this positive factor proves the formula on the inserted set. Every factorial denominator is positive; zero values of $a,b,m$ are included.

proof_steps.title: Sum weights over all supersets of a fixed subset
proof_steps.body_md: Let $k>0$, $L\subseteq E$, $m=|E|$, $l=|L|$ and $R=E\setminus L$. Each $S$ with $L\subseteq S\subseteq E$ uniquely equals $L\cup A$ with $A\subseteq R$. Thus $|S|=l+|A|$ and $|R|=m-l$. Apply the preceding convolution with $a=l$ and $b=k-1$. Use $k(k-1)!=k!$ and cancel the positive large factorial $(m+k)!$ to obtain the displayed weight sum. Both $L=\varnothing$ and $L=E$ are included.

proof_steps.title: Exchange the sums to obtain the weighted finite-difference transform
proof_steps.body_md: Disjointness of $T,E$ gives $\Delta_Tg(S)=\sum_{U\subseteq S}w_{T\cup U}$. Every pair $U\subseteq S\subseteq E$ occurs exactly once, so exchange the finite sums. For fixed $U$, the preceding superset-weight identity supplies precisely the displayed coefficient of $w_{T\cup U}$.

en.title: Shared proof: classical Shapley equals equal dividend allocation
assumptions: $i\in N$; $\phi_g$ is defined by the classical factorial-weighted marginal formula; $n=|N|\ge1$.

definitions.body_md: Fix a finite universe $N$. A game $g:\mathcal P(N)\to\mathbb R$ has output baseline $b=g(\varnothing)$ and interaction $I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U)$. Write $w_A=I_g(A)$. Every subset sum includes the empty set, and $w_\varnothing=b$. The finite difference is $\Delta_Tg(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}g(L\cup S)$. No zero output baseline is assumed. Centering $g_0=g-b$ removes only the empty dividend.

proof_steps.title: Start from the classical factorial-weighted definition
proof_steps.body_md: Let $i\in N$, so $n=|N|\ge1$. Classical Shapley weights each environment marginal $g(S\cup\{i\})-g(S)=\Delta_{\{i\}}g(S)$ by $|S|!(n-|S|-1)!/n!$, for $S\subseteq N\setminus\{i\}$.

proof_steps.title: Prove the finite factorial convolution
Sum weights over all supersets of a fixed subset
Exchange the sums to obtain the weighted finite-difference transform
Check all parameters of the shared identity
proof_steps.body_md: Set $T=\{i\}$, $E=N\setminus\{i\}$ and $k=1$. Then $m=n-1$, and the left weight is exactly the classical Shapley weight. The right coefficient is $\binom{|U|+1}{1}^{-1}=1/(|U|+1)$. The difference target and environment are disjoint and the order is positive, so every premise of the shared identity is satisfied.

proof_steps.title: Check the baseline and a two-variable example
proof_steps.body_md: For outputs 7, 8, 9 and 13, the dividends are 7, 1, 2 and 3. The two Shapley values are $1+3/2=5/2$ and $2+3/2=7/2$, summing to $6=g(N)-b$. The environment may be empty, but a dividend allocated to $i$ always contains $i$ and is nonempty. The baseline is not allocated. For a one-player game the sole environment is empty and its value is the singleton output minus the baseline.

definitions.body_md: Fix a finite universe $N$. A game $g:\mathcal P(N)\to\mathbb R$ has output baseline $b=g(\varnothing)$ and interaction $I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U)$. Write $w_A=I_g(A)$. Every subset sum includes the empty set, and $w_\varnothing=b$. The finite difference is $\Delta_Tg(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}g(L\cup S)$. No zero output baseline is assumed. Centering $g_0=g-b$ removes only the empty dividend.

proof_steps.body_md: Put $t=|T|$, $E=N\setminus T$ and $m=n-t$. SII uses the whole-target finite difference with weight $|S|!(m-|S|)!/(m+1)!$. It does not allocate separately to the members of $T$. The source domain includes both $T=\varnothing$ and $T=N$.

For $T=N$, the environment is empty and the result is $w_N$. For an empty target, the left side is the indicated weighted average of raw outputs and the right side includes the empty dividend $b$.

proof_steps.body_md: For outputs 7, 8, 9 and 13, the dividends are 7, 1, 2 and 3. SII at the full target equals 3; at the first singleton it equals $5/2$. For the empty target the factorial formula gives $7/3+8/6+9/6+13/3=19/2$, agreeing with $7+1/2+2/2+3/3=19/2$ from the dividend formula.

proof_steps.body_md: 令 $N=\{1,2\}$，$g(\varnothing)=7$、$g(\{1\})=8$、$g(\{2\})=9$、$g(\{1,2\})=13$。于是 $w_\varnothing=7$、$w_{\{1\}}=1$、$w_{\{2\}}=2$、$w_{\{1,2\}}=3$。 当 $k=1$，空目标值为7，两单变量目标分别为 $5/2$、$7/2$，二变量目标高于 $k$，值为零。当 $k=2$，四个目标的值为7、1、2、3，总和13。若 $N=\varnothing$ 而 $k\ge1$，仅有低阶空目标，值为 $b$。正阶数是当前定义域解释；原文仅写第 $k$ 阶，未显式写出不等式。

noncomputable def shapleyTaylor (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) (k : ℕ) (T : Finset α) : ℝ :=
  if T.card < k then higherMarginal g T ∅

theorem factorialWeight_eq_inv_choose (k m s : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hsm : s ≤ m) :
    factorialWeight k m s =
      (k : ℝ) / (m + k : ℝ) * (1 / ((m + k - 1).choose s : ℝ)) := by
  have ha : s ≤ m + k - 1 := by omega
  have he : k - 1 + m - s = m + k - 1 - s := by omega
  have hn : m + k - 1 + 1 = m + k := by omega
  have hcne : ((m + k - 1).choose s : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.choose_pos ha))
  have hfne : ((m + k - 1).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero _
  have hnne : (m + k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hch : ((m + k - 1).choose s : ℝ) * (s.factorial : ℝ) *
      ((m + k - 1 - s).factorial : ℝ) = ((m + k - 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial ha
  have hchval : (s.factorial : ℝ) * ((m + k - 1 - s).factorial : ℝ) =
      ((m + k - 1).factorial : ℝ) / ((m + k - 1).choose s : ℝ) := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hcne).mpr
    nlinarith only [hch]
  have hfac : ((m + k).factorial : ℝ) =
      (m + k : ℝ) * ((m + k - 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hn]
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, hn]
    simp
  unfold factorialWeight
  rw [he, hfac]
  calc
    _ = (k : ℝ) * ((s.factorial : ℝ) * ((m + k - 1 - s).factorial : ℝ)) /
        ((m + k : ℝ) * ((m + k - 1).factorial : ℝ)) := by ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [hchval]
      field_simp [hcne, hfne, hnne]

theorem factorial_powerset_sum (R : Finset α) (a b : ℕ) :
    (∑ U ∈ R.powerset, ((a + U.card).factorial : ℝ) *
      ((b + R.card - U.card).factorial : ℝ)) =
    (a.factorial : ℝ) * (b.factorial : ℝ) *
      ((a + b + R.card + 1).factorial : ℝ) / ((a + b + 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
  have fact_ne : ∀ n : ℕ, (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro n
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero n
  have fact_succ : ∀ n : ℕ, ((n + 1).factorial : ℝ) =
      (n + 1 : ℝ) * (n.factorial : ℝ) := by
    intro n
    simp [Nat.factorial_succ]
  induction R using Finset.induction_on generalizing a b with
  | empty =>
    simp only [powerset_empty, sum_singleton, card_empty, Nat.add_zero, Nat.sub_zero]
    field_simp [fact_ne]
  | @insert i R hi ih =>
    rw [sum_powerset_insert hi, card_insert_of_notMem hi]
    have h₁ : ∀ U ∈ R.powerset,
        ((a + U.card).factorial : ℝ) * ((b + (R.card + 1) - U.card).factorial : ℝ) =
          ((a + U.card).factorial : ℝ) * (((b + 1) + R.card - U.card).factorial : ℝ) := by
      intro U hU
      have he : b + (R.card + 1) - U.card = (b + 1) + R.card - U.card := by omega
      rw [he]
    have h₂ : ∀ U ∈ R.powerset,
        ((a + (insert i U).card).factorial : ℝ) *
          ((b + (R.card + 1) - (insert i U).card).factorial : ℝ) =
        (((a + 1) + U.card).factorial : ℝ) * ((b + R.card - U.card).factorial : ℝ) := by
      intro U hU
      have hiU : i ∉ U := fun hit => hi ((mem_powerset.mp hU) hit)
      rw [card_insert_of_notMem hiU]
      have hc := card_le_card (mem_powerset.mp hU)
      have he₁ : a + (U.card + 1) = (a + 1) + U.card := by omega
      have he₂ : b + (R.card + 1) - (U.card + 1) = b + R.card - U.card := by omega
      rw [he₁, he₂]
    rw [sum_congr rfl h₁, sum_congr rfl h₂, ih a (b + 1), ih (a + 1) b]
    have hd₁ : a + (b + 1) + 1 = (a + b + 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hd₂ : (a + 1) + b + 1 = (a + b + 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hn₁ : a + (b + 1) + R.card + 1 = a + b + (R.card + 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hn₂ : (a + 1) + b + R.card + 1 = a + b + (R.card + 1) + 1 := by omega
    rw [hd₁, hd₂, hn₁, hn₂, fact_succ a, fact_succ b, fact_succ (a + b + 1)]
    have hp : (a + b + 1 + 1 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp [fact_ne, hp]
    push_cast
    ring

theorem sum_supersets_eq_sum_complement (N L : Finset α) (hLN : L ⊆ N)
    (f : Game α) :
    (∑ S ∈ N.powerset, if L ⊆ S then f S else 0) =
      ∑ U ∈ (N \ L).powerset, f (L ∪ U) := by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun U _ => L ∪ U) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro U hU
    have hUR := mem_powerset.mp hU
    apply mem_filter.mpr
    exact ⟨mem_powerset.mpr (union_subset hLN (hUR.trans sdiff_subset)), subset_union_left⟩
  · intro U hU V hV he
    change L ∪ U = L ∪ V at he
    have hUR := mem_powerset.mp hU
    have hVR := mem_powerset.mp hV
    ext i
    constructor
    · intro hiU
      have hiL : i ∉ L := (mem_sdiff.mp (hUR hiU)).2
      have hh : i ∈ L ∪ V := by rw [← he]; exact mem_union_right L hiU
      simpa [hiL] using hh
    · intro hiV
      have hiL : i ∉ L := (mem_sdiff.mp (hVR hiV)).2
      have hh : i ∈ L ∪ U := by rw [he]; exact mem_union_right L hiV
      simpa [hiL] using hh
  · intro S hS
    have hSN := mem_powerset.mp (mem_filter.mp hS).1
    have hLS := (mem_filter.mp hS).2
    refine ⟨S \ L, mem_powerset.mpr ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i hi
      exact mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hSN (mem_sdiff.mp hi).1, (mem_sdiff.mp hi).2⟩
    · exact union_sdiff_of_subset hLS
  · intro U _
    rfl

theorem factorialWeight_superset_sum (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k)
    (N L : Finset α) (hLN : L ⊆ N) :
    (∑ S ∈ N.powerset, if L ⊆ S then factorialWeight k N.card S.card else 0) =
      (L.card.factorial : ℝ) * (k.factorial : ℝ) / ((L.card + k).factorial : ℝ) := by
  rw [sum_supersets_eq_sum_complement N L hLN]
  have hcard := card_le_card hLN
  have hR : (N \ L).card = N.card - L.card := card_sdiff_of_subset hLN
  have hterm : ∀ U ∈ (N \ L).powerset,
      factorialWeight k N.card (L ∪ U).card =
        (k : ℝ) / ((N.card + k).factorial : ℝ) *
          (((L.card + U.card).factorial : ℝ) *
            ((k - 1 + (N \ L).card - U.card).factorial : ℝ)) := by
    intro U hU
    have hUR := mem_powerset.mp hU
    have hLU : Disjoint L U := by
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro i hiL hiU
      exact (mem_sdiff.mp (hUR hiU)).2 hiL
    rw [card_union_of_disjoint hLU]
    have hcU : U.card ≤ (N \ L).card := card_le_card hUR
    have he : k - 1 + N.card - (L.card + U.card) = k - 1 + (N \ L).card - U.card := by
      omega
    simp only [factorialWeight, he]
    ring
  rw [sum_congr rfl hterm, ← Finset.mul_sum, factorial_powerset_sum]
  have hn : L.card + (k - 1) + (N \ L).card + 1 = N.card + k := by omega
  have hd : L.card + (k - 1) + 1 = L.card + k := by omega
  have hk₁ : (k - 1) + 1 = k := by omega
  have hfac : (k.factorial : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) * ((k - 1).factorial : ℝ) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← hk₁]
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul, hk₁]
  rw [hn, hd, hfac]
  have hne : ((N.card + k).factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero _
  field_simp [hne]

theorem shapleyTaylor_eq_dividends (g : Game α) (N T : Finset α) (hTN : T ⊆ N)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    shapleyTaylor g N k T =
      if T.card < k then interaction g T
      else if T.card = k then
        ∑ S ∈ (N \ T).powerset, (1 / ((S.card + k).choose k : ℝ)) * interaction g (T ∪ S)
      else 0 := by

  split_ifs with hlow htop
  · simp [higherMarginal]
  · have hm : (N \ T).card = N.card - k := by rw [card_sdiff_of_subset hTN, htop]
    have hn : (N \ T).card + k = N.card := by
      have ht := card_le_card hTN
      omega
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    have he : ∀ S ∈ (N \ T).powerset,
        (k : ℝ) / N.card * ((1 / ((N.card - 1).choose S.card : ℝ)) * higherMarginal g T S) =

      rw [hnr]

    rw [sum_congr rfl he, weighted_higherMarginal_eq _ _ _ disjoint_sdiff_self_right k hk]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro S _
    rw [factorial_ratio_eq_choose_inv]

theorem shapley_taylor {X : Type*} {n : ℕ} (v : X → ℝ)
    (mask : Finset (Fin n) → X) (T : Finset (Fin n)) (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) :
    shapleyTaylor (maskedGame v mask) univ k T =
      if T.card < k then interaction (maskedGame v mask) T
      else if T.card = k then
        ∑ S ∈ (univ \ T).powerset, (1 / ((S.card + k).choose k : ℝ)) *
          interaction (maskedGame v mask) (T ∪ S)
      else 0 := by
  exact shapleyTaylor_eq_dividends _ _ _ (subset_univ _) k hk

en.title: Shared proof: all three branches of the Shapley–Taylor index
assumptions: $T\subseteq N$; the original three-branch STI definition at a positive integer order $k>0$. The source does not explicitly state $k>0$; this is the positive-order domain interpretation. Order zero is outside the present verification scope.

definitions.body_md: Fix a finite universe $N$. A game $g:\mathcal P(N)\to\mathbb R$ has output baseline $b=g(\varnothing)$ and interaction $I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U)$. Write $w_A=I_g(A)$. Every subset sum includes the empty set, and $w_\varnothing=b$. The finite difference is $\Delta_Tg(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}g(L\cup S)$. No zero output baseline is assumed. Centering $g_0=g-b$ removes only the empty dividend.

proof_steps.title: Handle the lower and higher order branches
proof_steps.body_md: At a positive order $k$, if $|T|<k$, the finite difference in the empty environment is $w_T$ by definition; for an empty target its value is $b$. If $|T|>k$, the definition gives zero. These branches require neither division by $n$ nor $n\ge k$.

proof_steps.title: Convert the top-order weight to the shared factorial weight
proof_steps.body_md: If $|T|=k$, positivity and $T\subseteq N$ give $n\ge k\ge1$, so division by $n$ is valid. Put $E=N\setminus T$ and $m=n-k$. For $S\subseteq E$, its size $s$ satisfies $s\le m\le n-1$, making the relevant binomial coefficient positive. Expand its factorial definition and use $k(k-1)!=k!$ to obtain the displayed shared weight.

proof_steps.title: Prove the finite factorial convolution
Sum weights over all supersets of a fixed subset
Exchange the sums to obtain the weighted finite-difference transform
Apply the shared identity at the top order
proof_steps.body_md: The target and environment are disjoint and $k>0$, so the weighted finite-difference identity yields coefficient $\binom{|U|+k}{k}^{-1}$. Combining this with the lower and higher order definition branches proves the full three-branch statement.

proof_steps.title: Check empty targets and two positive orders
proof_steps.body_md: For the outputs 7, 8, 9 and 13, the dividends are 7, 1, 2 and 3. At $k=1$, the empty target has value 7, the singletons have values $5/2$ and $7/2$, and the pair is above the order and has value zero. At $k=2$, the four values are 7, 1, 2 and 3, summing to 13. If the universe is empty and $k\ge1$, only the lower-order empty target remains with value $b$. Positive order is the stated scope interpretation; the source does not explicitly print the inequality.

theorem interaction_additive_dummy_nonempty (g : Game α) (S : Finset α) (i : α)
    (hi : i ∉ S) (hS : S.Nonempty) (c : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ U ⊆ S, g (insert i U) = g U + c) :
    interaction g (insert i S) = 0 := by
  rw [interaction_insert _ _ _ hi]
  have he : interaction (marginal g i) S = interaction (fun _ => c) S := by
    apply interaction_congr
    intro U hU
    simp [marginal, h U hU]
  rw [he, interaction_const, if_neg hS.ne_empty]

assumptions: $i\in N\setminus S$; $S\ne\varnothing$; $c\in\mathbb R$; for every $U\subseteq S$, $g(U\cup\{i\})=g(U)+c$.

definitions.body_md: Fix a finite universe $N$. A game $g:\mathcal P(N)\to\mathbb R$ has output baseline $b=g(\varnothing)$ and interaction $I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U)$. Write $w_A=I_g(A)$. Every subset sum includes the empty set, and $w_\varnothing=b$. The finite difference is $\Delta_Tg(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}g(L\cup S)$. proof_steps.title: State the exact domain of the valid public property
proof_steps.body_md: This public result requires $S\ne\varnothing$ and has different quantifiers from the false CVPR proposition; it cannot replace that proposition. Since $i\notin S$ and the marginal is the constant $c$, the interaction containing $i$ equals the interaction of the constant game $c$ on $S$.
proof_steps.justification: The original Sparse statement can use this result if it already excludes empty environments; the original CVPR statement cannot.

proof_steps.title: Cancel all subsets by an explicit pairing
proof_steps.body_md: Pair subsets with and without $i$ to obtain $I_g(S\cup\{i\})=c\sum_{U\subseteq S}(-1)^{|S|-|U|}$. Choose $j\in S$, possible because $S$ is nonempty, and pair subsets with and without $j$. Their signs cancel, giving zero. For empty $S$, the sum equals $c$, demonstrating why the boundary condition is necessary.
proof_steps.justification: No assumption $g(\varnothing)=0$ is needed; the premises imply $c=g(\{i\})-g(\varnothing)$.

shared_proofs.statement_tex: \left[\forall z\in\mathbb R^n,\ \forall\kappa\in\mathbb N^n,\ |\kappa|\ge M+1:\ D^\kappa v(z)\text{存在且为}0\right]\ \Longrightarrow\ \forall S\subseteq N,\ |S|\ge M+1:\ I(S)=0

definitions.body_md: 固定 $N=\{1,\ldots,n\}$、模型 $v:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$、输入 $x$ 与输入基线 $r$。掩码在集合 $A$ 内取 $x_i$，其余取 $r_i$，定义 $g(A)=v(x_A)$、$b=g(\varnothing)$、$g_0(A)=g(A)-b$。原Sparse交互为 $I(A)=I_{g_0}(A)=\sum_{L\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|L|}g_0(L)$，故 $I(\varnothing)=0$。$e_i$ 是坐标单位向量；$a_i=x_i-r_i$ 是第 $i$ 个坐标的实际掩码增量。

proof_steps.title: 把原混合导数的存在与顺序展开
proof_steps.body_md: 经典偏导定义为 $D_i f(z)=\left.\frac{d}{dt}f(z+t e_i)\right|_{t=0}$。这等于把其余坐标固定、以第 $i$ 个坐标值为参数的普通导数。用非降序坐标列表 $(i_1,\ldots,i_q)$ 编码多重指标 $\kappa_i$：它等于列表中 $i$ 的出现次数，$q=\sum_i\kappa_i$。从左到右依次取偏导，定义 $P_0=v$、$P_j=D_{i_j}P_{j-1}$。原1-β的经典“混合导数存在且为零”要求相应前缀偏导沿下一坐标的导数真实存在，并给出 $P_q(z)=0$ 对全部 $z$。项目把这些存在条件与高阶零值一起编码在同一个1-β谓词中，只对原要求的 $q>M$ 列表使用它；没有另加所有低阶导数全局光滑的假设。原C1背景保留，但C1本身不保证高阶导数存在。原分母排写未另说明操作顺序，项目固定升序依次取导；如果采用反序约定，通用差分引理按同样的反序使用即可，不靠混合偏导换序。

theorem rectDifference_coordinate_eq_interaction (f : (α → ℝ) → ℝ) (h : α → ℝ)
    (indices : List α) (hnodup : indices.Nodup) (z : α → ℝ) :
    rectDifference (coordinateMoves h indices) f z = interaction (incrementGame f z h) indices.toFinset := by
  induction indices generalizing z with
  | nil =>
    simp only [coordinateMoves, List.map_nil, rectDifference, List.toFinset_nil,
      interaction_empty, incrementGame]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp [incrementCoordinates]
  | cons i rest ih =>
    rcases List.nodup_cons.mp hnodup with ⟨hi, hrest⟩
    have hi' : i ∉ rest.toFinset := by simpa using hi
    have he : interaction (incrementGame f (z + h i • coordinateDirection i) h) rest.toFinset =
        interaction (fun U => incrementGame f z h (insert i U)) rest.toFinset := by
      apply interaction_congr
      intro U hU
      have hiU : i ∉ U := fun hit => hi' (hU hit)
      simp only [incrementGame, incrementCoordinates_insert z h i U hiU]
    rw [List.toFinset_cons]
    change rectDifference (coordinateMoves h rest) f (z + h i • coordinateDirection i) -
      rectDifference (coordinateMoves h rest) f z =
      interaction (incrementGame f z h) (insert i rest.toFinset)
    rw [ih hrest, ih hrest, he, interaction_context_difference _ _ _ hi']

definitions.body_md: Fix $N=\{1,\ldots,n\}$, $v:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$, x, and r. The coordinate mask keeps x_i on A and r_i elsewhere. Let $g(A)=v(x_A)$, $b=g(\varnothing)$, and $g_0(A)=g(A)-b$. proof_steps.title: Classical mixed partials and their existence order
proof_steps.body_md: The classical partial is $D_i f(z)=\left.\frac d{dt}f(z+t e_i)\right|_{t=0}$. Encode a multiindex by a nondecreasing coordinate list $(i_1,\ldots,i_q)$, and define $P_0=v$, $P_j=D_{i_j}P_{j-1}$. Classical existence of the stated mixed partials includes actual differentiability of each required prefix along the next coordinate, and 1-β gives $P_q\equiv0$. These existence conditions and the zero value are encoded together; only lists q>M are used. No extra global smoothness of all low derivatives is assumed. C1 alone does not imply existence of high derivatives. A fixed ascending order is used; a reverse convention can use the same difference argument in reverse order, without interchanging mixed partials.

proof_steps.title: Commutation of finite differences and true partial derivatives
proof_steps.body_md: Define $\delta_{a,i}f(z)=f(z+a e_i)-f(z)$. If f is differentiable along coordinate i everywhere, its finitely many translated sums and differences are too. Translation gives $D_i(f(\cdot+h))(z)=D_i f(z+h)$ because $(z+t e_i)+h=(z+h)+t e_i$. The one-variable difference rule yields $D_i(\delta_{a,j}f)=\delta_{a,j}(D_i f)$. Induction extends this to arbitrary finite rectangular differences. Only translations and finite additions are used, with no infinite series or higher directional chain rule.

proof_steps.title: Zero mixed partials imply zero rectangular differences
proof_steps.body_md: Induct on the direction-list length q, allowing arbitrary directions and real steps. For the empty list, both the difference and the order-zero partial are f, and its assumed zero value proves the claim. For a nonempty list, let R denote the remaining differences. The prefix-existence premise applies the induction hypothesis to $D_{i_1}f$, giving $R(D_{i_1}f)=0$. Commutation then gives $D_{i_1}(Rf)=0$. For fixed z, $H(t)=(Rf)(z+t e_{i_1})$ is differentiable on the whole real line with zero derivative. The mean value theorem gives $H(a_{i_1})=H(0)$, so the full rectangular difference is zero. Negative and zero steps require no new restrictions.

theorem or_reconstruction (g : Game α) (N T : Finset α) (hTN : T ⊆ N) :
    orReconstruction g N T = g T := by
  let f : Game α := fun L => -g (N \ L)
  have hneg (S : Finset α) :
      interaction f S = -interaction (fun L => g (N \ L)) S := by
    simp [f, interaction, mul_neg, sum_neg_distrib]
  have hcoeff : ∀ S ∈ N.powerset.filter (fun S => ¬ Disjoint S T),
      orInteraction g N S = interaction f S := by
    intro S hS
    have hne : S ≠ ∅ := by
      intro he
      subst S
      simpa using (mem_filter.mp hS).2
    rw [orInteraction, if_neg hne, hneg]
  unfold orReconstruction
  rw [sum_congr rfl hcoeff, activated_subset_sum, reconstruction, reconstruction]
  have hcomp : N \ (N \ T) = T := by
    ext i
    simp only [mem_sdiff]
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_contra hiT
      exact h.2 ⟨h.1, hiT⟩
    · intro hiT
      exact ⟨hTN hiT, fun h => h.2 hiT⟩
  simp [f, orInteraction, hcomp]

en.title: Shared proof: exact reconstruction by the OR complement transform
assumptions: $T\subseteq N$; $g:\mathcal P(N)\to\mathbb R$. Nonempty OR dividends are the negative AND transform of the complement game; the empty OR dividend is the original output baseline.

definitions.body_md: Fix a finite universe $N$. A game $g:\mathcal P(N)\to\mathbb R$ has output baseline $b=g(\varnothing)$ and interaction $I_g(A)=\sum_{U\subseteq A}(-1)^{|A|-|U|}g(U)$. Write $w_A=I_g(A)$. Every subset sum includes the empty set, and $w_\varnothing=b$. The finite difference is $\Delta_Tg(S)=\sum_{L\subseteq T}(-1)^{|T|-|L|}g(L\cup S)$. No zero output baseline is assumed. Centering $g_0=g-b$ removes only the empty dividend. For nonempty targets, $O_g^N(S)=-I_{g^c}(S)$ where $g^c(L)=g(N\setminus L)$; the empty OR coefficient is $g(\varnothing)$.

proof_steps.title: Intersecting subsets are a difference of two powersets
proof_steps.body_md: For $T\subseteq N$ and $S\subseteq N$, disjointness from $T$ is equivalent to $S\subseteq N\setminus T$. Therefore the intersecting family is $\mathcal P(N)\setminus\mathcal P(N\setminus T)$. The second powerset is contained in the first, so its sum is subtracted from the full sum. The empty set belongs to both full families and to neither intersecting family.

proof_steps.title: Reconstruct the negative complement game twice
proof_steps.body_md: Let $f(L)=-h(N\setminus L)$. Linearity shows that each nonempty OR coefficient equals $I_f(S)$. Every intersecting set is nonempty, so substitute these coefficients throughout the intersecting sum. Apply reconstruction on $N$ and on $N\setminus T$ to obtain $f(N)-f(N\setminus T)=-h(\varnothing)+h(T)$. The final complement equality uses the checked premise $T\subseteq N$.

proof_steps.title: Add back the separately defined empty OR baseline
proof_steps.body_md: The empty OR coefficient is $h(\varnothing)=v_{or}(x_\varnothing)$. Adding it to the intersecting sum gives $v_{or}(x_T)$. For empty $T$, the intersecting family is empty and only the baseline remains; for $T=N$, the full output is recovered. This also avoids double-counting source cases when $T$ is empty.

en.title: Double counting flagged contexts
assumptions: A finite R with q=|R|, 0≤m<q, and f:2^R→ℝ.

definitions.body_md: Let N be a finite player set with n=|N|. Write $\mathcal C(R,m)=\{S\subseteq R:|S|=m\}$. The uniform average is $|\mathcal C|^{-1}\sum_{S\in\mathcal C}$; it represents the source probabilistic average only when m≤|R|.

en.overview: A flag is (S,j), where S⊂R, |S|=m and j∈R\S. The map to (T=S∪{j},j) is a bijection, inverted by (T\{j},j). Each size-(m+1) T has m+1 flags and each S has q−m flags.

theorem sum_insert_flags (R : Finset α) (m : ℕ) (f : Game α) :
    (∑ j ∈ R, ∑ S ∈ (R.erase j).powersetCard m, f (insert j S)) =
      (m+1 : ℝ) * ∑ T ∈ R.powersetCard (m+1), f T := by
  have hj (j : α) (hj : j ∈ R) :
      (∑ S ∈ (R.erase j).powersetCard m, f (insert j S)) =
        ∑ T ∈ (R.powersetCard (m+1)).filter (fun T => j ∈ T), f T := by
    refine sum_bij (fun S _ => insert j S) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    · intro S hS
      have hs := mem_powersetCard.mp hS
      have hn : j ∉ S := fun h => (mem_erase.mp (hs.1 h)).1 rfl
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_powersetCard.mpr
        ⟨insert_subset hj (hs.1.trans (erase_subset _ _)), by simpa [hn] using hs.2⟩,
        mem_insert_self _ _⟩
    · intro S hS U hU he
      have hn : j ∉ S := fun h => (mem_erase.mp ((mem_powersetCard.mp hS).1 h)).1 rfl
      have hm : j ∉ U := fun h => (mem_erase.mp ((mem_powersetCard.mp hU).1 h)).1 rfl
      simpa [hn,hm] using congrArg (fun T => T.erase j) he
    · intro T hT
      have ht := mem_powersetCard.mp (mem_filter.mp hT).1
      have hjT := (mem_filter.mp hT).2
      refine ⟨T.erase j, mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨erase_subset_erase j ht.1, ?_⟩, insert_erase hjT⟩
      have hc := card_erase_add_one hjT
      omega
    · intro S _; rfl
  rw [sum_congr rfl hj]
  simp_rw [sum_filter]
  rw [sum_comm]
  calc
    _ = ∑ T ∈ R.powersetCard (m+1), (T.card : ℝ)*f T := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro T hT
      have ht := (mem_powersetCard.mp hT).1
      have hsum : (∑ j ∈ R, if j ∈ T then f T else 0) = ∑ j ∈ T, f T := by
        rw [← sum_filter]
        congr 1
        ext j
        simp only [mem_filter]
        exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨ht h,h⟩⟩
      rw [hsum]; simp
    _ = _ := by
      rw [mul_sum]
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro T hT
      rw [(mem_powersetCard.mp hT).2]; simp

 theorem sum_erase_contexts (R : Finset α) (m : ℕ) (f : α → Game α) :
    (∑ j ∈ R, ∑ S ∈ (R.erase j).powersetCard m, f j S) =
      ∑ S ∈ R.powersetCard m, ∑ j ∈ R \ S, f j S := by
  have he (j : α) : (R.erase j).powersetCard m =
      (R.powersetCard m).filter (fun S => j ∉ S) := by
    ext S
    simp only [mem_powersetCard, mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h,c⟩
      exact ⟨⟨h.trans (erase_subset _ _),c⟩, fun hj => (mem_erase.mp (h hj)).1 rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨h,c⟩,hn⟩
      exact ⟨fun x hx => mem_erase.mpr ⟨fun h => hn (h ▸ hx),h hx⟩,c⟩
  simp_rw [he, sum_filter]
  rw [sum_comm]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro S _
  rw [sdiff_eq_filter, sum_filter]

 theorem sum_erase_same (R : Finset α) (m : ℕ) (f : Game α) :
    (∑ j ∈ R, ∑ S ∈ (R.erase j).powersetCard m, f S) =
      (R.card-m : ℝ) * ∑ S ∈ R.powersetCard m, f S := by
  rw [sum_erase_contexts, mul_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro S hS
  have hs := mem_powersetCard.mp hS
  have hc := card_le_card hs.1
  rw [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, card_sdiff_of_subset hs.1, hs.2, Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]

 theorem context_average_step (R : Finset α) (m : ℕ) (hm : m < R.card) (f : Game α) :
    contextAverage R (m+1) f - contextAverage R m f =
      average R (fun j => contextAverage (R.erase j) m (fun S => f (insert j S)-f S)) := by
  have hR : (R.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : R.card ≠ 0)
  have h0 : ((R.powersetCard m).card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (card_ne_zero.mpr (powersetCard_nonempty.mpr (by omega)))
  have h1 : ((R.powersetCard (m+1)).card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (card_ne_zero.mpr (powersetCard_nonempty.mpr (by omega)))
  have he : ((R.card-1).choose m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (Nat.ne_of_gt (Nat.choose_pos (by omega)))
  have hcard (j : α) (hj : j ∈ R) :
      ((R.erase j).powersetCard m).card = (R.card-1).choose m := by
    rw [card_powersetCard, card_erase_of_mem hj]
  have hn0 : (R.card : ℝ) * ((R.card-1).choose m : ℝ) =
      (R.card-m : ℝ) * ((R.powersetCard m).card : ℝ) := by
    have h := sum_erase_same R m (fun _ => 1)
    simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
    rw [sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)) (hcard j hj))] at h
    simpa using h
  have hn1 : (R.card : ℝ) * ((R.card-1).choose m : ℝ) =
      (m+1 : ℝ) * ((R.powersetCard (m+1)).card : ℝ) := by
    have h := sum_insert_flags R m (fun _ => 1)
    simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] at h
    rw [sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)) (hcard j hj))] at h
    simpa using h
  have hs : (∑ j ∈ R, contextAverage (R.erase j) m (fun S => f (insert j S)-f S)) =
      ((R.card-1).choose m : ℝ)⁻¹ *
        ((m+1 : ℝ)*(∑ T ∈ R.powersetCard (m+1), f T) -
         (R.card-m : ℝ)*(∑ S ∈ R.powersetCard m, f S)) := by
    unfold contextAverage average
    rw [sum_congr rfl (fun j hj => by rw [hcard j hj])]
    rw [← mul_sum]
    simp_rw [sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [sum_insert_flags, sum_erase_same]
  change average (R.powersetCard (m+1)) f - average (R.powersetCard m) f = (R.card : ℝ)⁻¹ * _
  rw [hs]
  unfold average
  field_simp [hR,h0,h1,he]
  linear_combination (∑ T ∈ R.powersetCard (m+1), f T) * ((R.powersetCard m).card : ℝ) * hn1 - ((R.powersetCard (m+1)).card : ℝ) * (∑ S ∈ R.powersetCard m, f S) * hn0

 theorem attribution_recurrence (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) (i : α) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : m < (N.erase i).card) :
    multiOrderAttribution g N i (m+1)-multiOrderAttribution g N i m =
      average (N.erase i) (fun j => multiOrderInteraction g N i j m) := by
  rw [multiOrderAttribution, multiOrderAttribution,
    context_average_step (N.erase i) m hm]
  unfold average
  apply congrArg (fun t : ℝ => ((N.erase i).card : ℝ)⁻¹*t)
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  have he : (N.erase i).erase j = N \ {i,j} := by
    ext a; simp only [mem_erase, mem_sdiff, mem_insert, mem_singleton]; tauto
  change contextAverage ((N.erase i).erase j) m (fun S => _) = multiOrderInteraction g N i j m
  rw [he]
  unfold multiOrderInteraction
  apply congrArg (contextAverage (N \ {i,j}) m)
  funext S
  unfold pairDelta
  rw [insert_comm]; ring

 theorem factorial_average_orders (R : Finset α) (f : Game α) :
    (∑ S ∈ R.powerset, factorialWeight 1 R.card S.card*f S) =
      (R.card+1 : ℝ)⁻¹ * ∑ m ∈ range (R.card+1), contextAverage R m f := by
  rw [sum_powerset, mul_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  have hmR : m ≤ R.card := by have := mem_range.mp hm; omega
  unfold contextAverage average
  simp_rw [mul_sum]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro S hS
  rw [(mem_powersetCard.mp hS).2,
    factorialWeight_eq_inv_choose 1 R.card m (by omega) hmR, card_powersetCard]
  simp; ring

 theorem shapley_orders (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) (i : α) (hi : i ∈ N) :
    factorialShapley g N i = (N.card : ℝ)⁻¹ *
      ∑ m ∈ range N.card, multiOrderAttribution g N i m := by
  have hc := card_erase_add_one hi
  unfold factorialShapley
  have ht : ∀ S ∈ (N.erase i).powerset,
    (S.card.factorial : ℝ)*((N.card-S.card-1).factorial : ℝ)/(N.card.factorial : ℝ)*
      (g (insert i S)-g S) = factorialWeight 1 (N.erase i).card S.card*(g (insert i S)-g S) := by
    intro S _
    rw [factorialWeight_one]
    have he : N.card-S.card-1 = (N.erase i).card-S.card := by omega
    rw [he,hc]
  rw [sum_congr rfl ht, factorial_average_orders]
  have hcr : ((N.erase i).card : ℝ)+1 = (N.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hc
  rw [hc,hcr]; rfl

 theorem shapley_efficiency (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) :
    (∑ i ∈ N, factorialShapley g N i) = g N-g ∅ := by
  rw [sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => factorialShapley_eq_dividendAllocation g N i hi)]
  exact dividendAllocation_efficiency g N

 theorem attribution_efficiency (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) :
    (N.card : ℝ)⁻¹ * (∑ i ∈ N, ∑ m ∈ range N.card, multiOrderAttribution g N i m) =
      g N-g ∅ := by
  rw [mul_sum, ← sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => shapley_orders g N i hi)]
  exact shapley_efficiency g N

 theorem average_sum {β γ : Type*} (s : Finset β) (t : Finset γ) (f : β → γ → ℝ) :
    average s (fun b => ∑ c ∈ t, f b c) = ∑ c ∈ t, average s (fun b => f b c) := by
  unfold average
  rw [sum_comm, mul_sum]

 theorem attribution_accumulation (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) (i : α) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : m ≤ (N.erase i).card) :
    multiOrderAttribution g N i m = multiOrderAttribution g N i 0 +
      average (N.erase i) (fun j => ∑ k ∈ range m, multiOrderInteraction g N i j k) := by
  rw [average_sum]
  have h := accumulation_telescope (multiOrderAttribution g N i) m
  rw [sum_congr rfl (fun k hk => attribution_recurrence g N i k (by have := mem_range.mp hk; omega))] at h
  exact h

 theorem triangular_sum (a : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ m ∈ range (n+1), ∑ k ∈ range m, a k) =
      ∑ k ∈ range n, (n-k : ℝ)*a k := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [sum_range_succ, ih, sum_range_succ]
    rw [sum_range_succ]
    have he : ∀ k ∈ range n, (n+1-k : ℝ)*a k = (n-k : ℝ)*a k + a k := by
      intro k hk
      have hkN := mem_range.mp hk
      ring
    push_cast
    rw [sum_congr rfl he, sum_add_distrib]
    ring

 theorem average_map {β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] (e : α ↪ β) (s : Finset α) (f : β → ℝ) :
    average (s.map e) f = average s (fun a => f (e a)) := by
  simp [average, sum_map]

 theorem contextAverage_map {β : Type*} [DecidableEq β] (e : α ↪ β) (R : Finset α)
    (m : ℕ) (f : Game β) :
    contextAverage (R.map e) m f = contextAverage R m (fun S => f (S.map e)) := by
  unfold contextAverage
  rw [powersetCard_map, average_map]
  rfl

 theorem attribution_relabel (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) (i : α) (m : ℕ) (e : α ≃ α) :
    multiOrderAttribution g (N.map e.toEmbedding) (e i) m =
      multiOrderAttribution (fun S => g (S.map e.toEmbedding)) N i m := by
  unfold multiOrderAttribution
  have he := map_erase e.toEmbedding N i
  simp only [Equiv.coe_toEmbedding] at he
  rw [← he, contextAverage_map]
  apply congrArg (contextAverage (N.erase i) m)
  funext S
  simp [map_insert]

 theorem interaction_relabel (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) (i j : α) (m : ℕ) (e : α ≃ α) :
    multiOrderInteraction g (N.map e.toEmbedding) (e i) (e j) m =
      multiOrderInteraction (fun S => g (S.map e.toEmbedding)) N i j m := by
  unfold multiOrderInteraction
  have he : (N.map e.toEmbedding) \ {e i,e j} = (N \ {i,j}).map e.toEmbedding := by
    simp [map_sdiff]
  rw [he, contextAverage_map]
  apply congrArg (contextAverage (N \ {i,j}) m)
  funext S
  simp [pairDelta, map_insert]

 theorem swap_map_self (i j : α) (S : Finset α) (h : i ∈ S ↔ j ∈ S) :
    S.map (Equiv.swap i j).toEmbedding = S := by
  ext a
  simp only [mem_map_equiv, Equiv.symm_swap]
  by_cases ha : a=i
  · subst a; simpa using h.symm
  by_cases hb : a=j
  · subst a; simpa using h
  rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne ha hb]

 theorem swap_game_of_cooperation (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) (i j : α)
    (h : ∀ R ⊆ N \ {i,j}, g (insert i R)=g (insert j R))
    (S : Finset α) (hS : S ⊆ N) :
    g (S.map (Equiv.swap i j).toEmbedding) = g S := by
  by_cases hi : i ∈ S <;> by_cases hj : j ∈ S
  · rw [swap_map_self i j S (by simp [hi,hj])]
  · have hr : S.erase i ⊆ N \ {i,j} := by
      intro a ha
      have hs := mem_erase.mp ha
      exact mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hS hs.2, by simp only [mem_insert, mem_singleton]; rintro (he | he); exact hs.1 he; exact hj (he ▸ hs.2)⟩
    have hjr : j ∉ S.erase i := fun hh => hj (mem_of_mem_erase hh)
    have he : S.map (Equiv.swap i j).toEmbedding = insert j (S.erase i) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← insert_erase hi]
      simp only [map_insert, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
      rw [swap_map_self i j (S.erase i) (by simp [hjr])]
    rw [he, ← h (S.erase i) hr, insert_erase hi]
  · have hr : S.erase j ⊆ N \ {i,j} := by
      intro a ha
      have hs := mem_erase.mp ha
      exact mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨hS hs.2, by simp only [mem_insert, mem_singleton]; rintro (he | he); exact hi (he ▸ hs.2); exact hs.1 he⟩
    have hir : i ∉ S.erase j := fun hh => hi (mem_of_mem_erase hh)
    have he : S.map (Equiv.swap i j).toEmbedding = insert i (S.erase j) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← insert_erase hj]
      simp only [map_insert, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, Equiv.swap_apply_right]
      rw [swap_map_self i j (S.erase j) (by simp [hir])]
    rw [he, h (S.erase j) hr, insert_erase hj]
  · rw [swap_map_self i j S (by simp [hi,hj])]

 theorem attribution_congr (g h : Game α) (N : Finset α) (i : α) (m : ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ N) (hh : ∀ S ⊆ N, g S=h S) :
    multiOrderAttribution g N i m = multiOrderAttribution h N i m := by
  unfold multiOrderAttribution contextAverage average
  congr 1
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro S hS
  have hs := (mem_powersetCard.mp hS).1.trans (erase_subset _ _)
  change g (insert i S)-g S = h (insert i S)-h S
  rw [hh S hs, hh (insert i S) (insert_subset hi hs)]

 theorem interaction_congr (g h : Game α) (N : Finset α) (i j : α) (m : ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ N) (hj : j ∈ N) (hh : ∀ S ⊆ N, g S=h S) :
    multiOrderInteraction g N i j m = multiOrderInteraction h N i j m := by
  unfold multiOrderInteraction contextAverage average
  congr 1
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro S hS
  have hs := (mem_powersetCard.mp hS).1.trans sdiff_subset
  unfold pairDelta
  rw [hh S hs, hh (insert i S) (insert_subset hi hs), hh (insert j S) (insert_subset hj hs),
    hh (insert i (insert j S)) (insert_subset hi (insert_subset hj hs))]

 theorem attribution_symmetry (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) (i j : α) (m : ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ N) (hj : j ∈ N)
    (h : ∀ R ⊆ N \ {i,j}, g (insert i R)=g (insert j R)) :
    multiOrderAttribution g N i m = multiOrderAttribution g N j m := by
  have hn := swap_map_self i j N (by simp [hi,hj])
  have he := attribution_relabel g N i m (Equiv.swap i j)
  rw [hn, Equiv.swap_apply_left] at he
  rw [he]
  exact attribution_congr g _ N i m hi (fun S hS => (swap_game_of_cooperation g N i j h S hS).symm)

 theorem interaction_symmetry (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) (i j k : α) (m : ℕ)
    (hi : i ∈ N) (hj : j ∈ N) (hk : k ∈ N) (hki : k ≠ i) (hkj : k ≠ j)
    (h : ∀ R ⊆ N \ {i,j}, g (insert i R)=g (insert j R)) :
    multiOrderInteraction g N i k m = multiOrderInteraction g N j k m := by
  have hn := swap_map_self i j N (by simp [hi,hj])
  have he := interaction_relabel g N i k m (Equiv.swap i j)
  rw [hn, Equiv.swap_apply_left, Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hki hkj] at he
  rw [he]
  exact interaction_congr g _ N i k m hi hk (fun S hS => (swap_game_of_cooperation g N i j h S hS).symm)

 theorem order_sum_accumulation (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) (i : α) (hi : i ∈ N) :
    (∑ m ∈ range N.card, multiOrderAttribution g N i m) =
      (N.card : ℝ)*multiOrderAttribution g N i 0 +
        average (N.erase i) (fun j => ∑ k ∈ range (N.erase i).card,
          ((N.erase i).card-k : ℝ)*multiOrderInteraction g N i j k) := by
  have hc := card_erase_add_one hi
  rw [sum_congr rfl (fun m hm => attribution_accumulation g N i m (by have := mem_range.mp hm; omega))]
  rw [sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [← average_sum, ← hc]
  apply congrArg (average (N.erase i))
  funext j
  exact triangular_sum (multiOrderInteraction g N i j) (N.erase i).card

 theorem interaction_efficiency (g : Game α) (N : Finset α) (hN : 2 ≤ N.card) :
    g N = g ∅ + (∑ i ∈ N, multiOrderAttribution g N i 0) +
      ∑ i ∈ N, ∑ j ∈ N.erase i, ∑ m ∈ range (N.card-1),
        ((N.card : ℝ)-1-m)/((N.card : ℝ)*((N.card : ℝ)-1))*multiOrderInteraction g N i j m := by
  have hn : (N.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : N.card ≠ 0)
  have hn1 : (N.card : ℝ)-1 ≠ 0 := by
    have hreal : (2:ℝ) ≤ N.card := by exact_mod_cast hN
    linarith
  have hp (i : α) (hi : i ∈ N) :
    (N.card : ℝ)⁻¹*(∑ m ∈ range N.card, multiOrderAttribution g N i m) =
      multiOrderAttribution g N i 0 + ∑ j ∈ N.erase i, ∑ m ∈ range (N.card-1),
        ((N.card : ℝ)-1-m)/((N.card : ℝ)*((N.card : ℝ)-1))*multiOrderInteraction g N i j m := by
    rw [order_sum_accumulation g N i hi]
    have hc : (N.erase i).card = N.card-1 := card_erase_of_mem hi
    have hcr : ((N.erase i).card : ℝ) = (N.card : ℝ)-1 := by
      rw [hc, Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_one]
    unfold average
    have hcrN : ((N.card-1 : ℕ):ℝ) = (N.card : ℝ)-1 := by rw [← hc,hcr]
    rw [hc,hcrN,mul_add,mul_sum]
    have hbase : (N.card : ℝ)⁻¹*((N.card : ℝ)*multiOrderAttribution g N i 0) =
      multiOrderAttribution g N i 0 := by field_simp
    rw [hbase]
    congr 1
    simp_rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    apply sum_congr rfl
    intro m hm
    field_simp [hn,hn1]
  have h := attribution_efficiency g N
  rw [mul_sum, sum_congr rfl hp, sum_add_distrib] at h
  linarith
